description: This file defines the Vtiger_Utils class providing utility functions for file access validation, database operations, logging, and SQL statement analysis within the vtiger CRM system.

classes.name: Vtiger_Utils
classes.description: Utility class providing methods for data validation, file security checks, database table management, logging, and SQL analysis.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Checks if a value is numeric and equals its integer conversion.

methods.name: implodestr
methods.description: Creates a string by repeating a prefix and optional suffix a specified number of times.

methods.name: checkFileAccessForInclusion
methods.description: Verifies if a file path is within the web root and not in unsafe directories for PHP inclusion.

methods.name: checkFileAccess
methods.description: Checks if a file path is within the web root directory.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Logs a message with optional end-of-line delimiter.

methods.name: SQLEscape
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe SQL inclusion.

methods.name: CheckTable
methods.description: Checks if a database table exists.

methods.name: CreateTable
methods.description: Creates a database table with optional engine and charset suffix.

methods.name: AddColumn
methods.description: Adds a column to a database table if it does not already exist.

methods.name: ExecuteQuery
methods.description: Executes an SQL query with optional suppression of errors.

methods.name: CreateTableSql
methods.description: Retrieves the CREATE TABLE SQL statement for a given table.

methods.name: IsCreateSql
methods.description: Determines if an SQL statement is a CREATE TABLE statement.

methods.name: IsDestructiveSql
methods.description: Checks if an SQL statement is destructive (DROP or DELETE).
